Media, etymologies and neighbouring literary/news examples are research context only and are not proposed learner fields.

## Modifications

One selected everyday sense is proposed per group. Definitions and explanations retain the selected POS, construction and register. IPA is selected from an attested notation, with slashes added. `nôtres` uses the attested possessive construction `les nôtres`; /notʁ/ is the second-word component, corroborated by the isolated spelling. `amen` is evidenced as a French interjection in English Wiktionary, with prayer-ending meaning and same-form French pronunciation corroborated separately. No runtime alias or pronunciation of another language is proposed.
